hero.headline: The best-reviewed nails in Palo Alto
hero.sub: From a clean classic set to full custom art, Marigold Nail Studio takes the time to get it right.

story.title: Welcome to Marigold Nail Studio
body: Marigold Nail Studio is a full-service nail studio in Palo Alto, where a licensed team handles everything from a clean classic manicure to sculpted extensions and custom art.

Every service starts with properly sterilized tools and a fresh file. We take the time to prep the nail correctly, because that is the difference between a set that lasts a weekend and one that lasts for weeks.
We are open 6 days a week, and walk-ins are always welcome — though a quick call to (650) 555-0142 guarantees your spot.

why.title: Genuinely warm service
why.body: You get greeted by name, not processed through a queue. Our regulars stay regulars for a reason.

why.title: Work that actually lasts
why.body: Proper prep and quality product mean gel and dip that hold up for weeks, not days.

why.title: A real spa experience
why.body: Massage chairs, a calm room, and time that never feels rushed — treatment, not transaction.

why.title: Custom nail art on request
why.body: Bring a screenshot or an idea. Our techs design freehand and match what you had in mind.

why.title: Spotless and sanitized
why.body: Fresh files, liners, and fully sterilized tools for every single guest — no exceptions.

why.title: Meticulous attention
why.body: Even cuticles, clean lines, and shaping that gets checked twice before you leave the chair.

reviews.author: Dana W.
reviews.text: My gel set lasted three full weeks with no chips or lifting. They spend real time on the prep instead of rushing straight to color, and you can tell the difference by week two.

reviews.author: Priya S.
reviews.text: Brought in a screenshot of a chrome French design I was sure was too fussy to copy. They matched it freehand, quoted the price up front, and there were no surprise add-ons at checkout.

reviews.author: Marisol T.
reviews.text: Walked in on a Saturday afternoon and got a straight answer about the wait instead of being parked for an hour. Spotless space, fresh file out of the packet, genuinely warm staff.

reviews.author: Renee K.
reviews.text: The pedicure is the most relaxing hour of my month. Massage chairs, quiet room, and nobody makes you feel rushed out of the seat when they are busy.

reviews.author: Alicia B.
reviews.text: I am picky about shaping and they got my almond set even on the first try. She checked both hands against each other twice before sending me to dry.

reviews.author: Joy N.
reviews.text: Took my daughter for her birthday and they treated her like a regular client. Sweet, patient, and the whole thing was priced fairly for what we got.

seo.title: Marigold Nail Studio | Nail Salon in Palo Alto, CA
seo.description: Marigold Nail Studio is a nail salon in Palo Alto, CA. Manicures, pedicures, gel, dip powder and custom nail art. Call (650) 555-0142.
